newsitem.title: USA: CME Nov lumber down limit on weak cash, technicals.
newsitem.headline: CME Nov lumber down limit on weak cash, technicals.

text.p: CME November lumber futures fell for a limit loss of $10.00 per tbf on persistent pressure from weak cash markets and technicals, traders said.
November fell the limit to $329.40 per tbf with other months down $8.80 to $1.70 per tbf.

Cash spruce prices were seen falling further as retailers substained from replenishing supplies and this added to technical weakness that developed when November fell under $339 per tbf early. Stops were touched off under $335 but prices fell the limit on mixed pressure, traders said.
